svg.aria-label: With QUIRE_TRACE_EMIT=1, trace("FR-001-AC-1") in a vitest test stores the id on the test's meta under quireTraceIds. TraceReporter reads it when the run ends and writes it to the JUnit file as a trace property on that test case.
svg.title: With QUIRE_TRACE_EMIT=1, trace("FR-001-AC-1") in a vitest test stores the id on the test's meta under quireTraceIds. TraceReporter reads it when the run ends and writes it to the JUnit file as a trace property on that test case.
